1.w: Hear, [my] sons, the discipline of a father, and pay attention to know understanding.

2.w: For good teaching I have given to you⁺; do not forsake my instruction.

3.w: For I was a son to my father, tender and the only one before the face of my mother,

4.w: and he instructed me and said to me, “Let your heart take hold of my words; keep my commands, and live.

5.w: Acquire wisdom; acquire understanding! Do not forget and do not bend away from the words of my mouth.

6.w: Do not forsake her, and she will preserve you; love her, and she will guard you.

7.w: The first [thing] [is] wisdom; acquire wisdom, and in all your acquiring, acquire understanding.

8.w: Lift her up, and she will exalt you; she will bring you honor when you embrace her.

9.w: She will give to your head a wreath of grace; a crown of beauty she will deliver to you.”

10.w: Hear, my son, and receive my sayings, and the years of life will be multiplied for you.

11.w: In the way of wisdom I have instructed you; I have made you step in paths of uprightness.

12.w: In your walking, your steps will not be restricted; and when you run, you will not stumble.

13.w: Hold on to instruction; do not let go; Guard her, for she [is] your life.

14.w: Do not enter into the path of the wicked ones, and do not walk in the way of evil ones.

15.w: Avoid it! Do not pass onto it; turn aside from it and pass by.

16.w: For they cannot sleep if they have not done evil; and their sleep is stolen if they do not they cause stumbling.

17.w: Indeed, they eat the bread of wickedness; they drink the wine of violence.

18.w: But the path of the righteous is like the light of brightness, and shining and going forth, until the day is established.

19.w: The way of the wicked [is] like the darkness—they do not know over what they stumble.

20.w: My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.

21.w: Do not let them depart from your eyes—keep them in the midst of your heart.

22.w: For they [are] life to those finding them, and to all his flesh healing.

23.w: With all diligence, guard your heart, for from it [are] the outgoings of life.

24.w: Turn away from you the crookedness of the mouth, and perverse lips put far from you.

25.w: Your eyes should look forward, and your eyelids keep straight before you.

26.w: Make level the path for your feet, and all your ways shall be established.

27.w: Do not bend away to the right or the left; turn aside your foot from evil.
